1083.description: Hamstring curl with heels in straps while bridging. It works the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

1147.description: Lying on your back with your feet in the straps, you curl the hips up to work the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

1211.description: A standing single-arm cable press with a rotation. It trains the chest and the core's ability to resist and produce twist.
instructions: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways with the handle in your inside hand.
Take a stable stance and hold the handle at your chest.
Press the handle forward while rotating your torso toward the press.
Return to the start with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

1275.description: A push-up that drops to the knees and presses back up. It trains the chest and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Once your chest is just above the ground, quickly drop your knees to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽。
将胸部压向地面，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你的胸部刚好高于地面时，迅速将膝盖放在地上。
伸展双臂，将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1339.description: Sit on a stability ball and reach one arm overhead as you lean to the other side. It stretches the lat and the side of your torso.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Slowly lean to the opposite side, feeling a stretch in your lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，然后将手臂伸直至头顶。
慢慢地向另一侧倾斜，感受背阔肌的拉伸。
保持伸展动作 20-30 秒，然后回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复。

1403.description: Gently tilt your head sideways to stretch the side of your neck. It eases tension in the neck and upper shoulder.
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear towards your shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side.
Perform 2-4 sets on each side.
instructionsZh: 站直或坐直，肩膀放松。
将头向一侧倾斜，将耳朵靠近肩膀。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
在另一侧重复。
每侧进行 2-4 组。

1467.description: A push-up with your forearms on the floor instead of your hands. It is tough on the triceps and the core.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the ground and elbows directly below your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从平板支撑位置开始，前臂放在地面上，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
调动你的核心力量，让你的身体从头到脚保持在一条直线上。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1531.description: A power snatch started from blocks. It trains the explosive pull and the overhead catch.
instructions: Set the bar on blocks and take a wide grip with a flat back.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1595.description: A front squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It trains the quads with an upright torso.
instructions: Set the bar at shoulder height and rest it on the front of your shoulders with elbows up.
Unrack it and step your feet slightly forward.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Press through your heels to stand and rerack when done.

1659.description: A hammer curl while sitting on an exercise ball. It trains the brachialis, biceps and core.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1723.description: A one-arm triceps pushdown on a cable. It isolates the triceps on one side at a time.
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a straight bar attachment at chest height.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip and step back to create tension in the cable.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Start with your arm fully extended and perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and push the bar down until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 面向缆绳机站立，并在胸部高度处安装直杆附件。
正手握住杠铃，然后后退以在绳索上产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
在整个练习过程中保持背部挺直并保持核心参与。
首先，手臂完全伸展并垂直于地板。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向下推，直到手臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后吸气，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1787.description: Reaching straight arms backward opens your chest and the front of your shoulders. Simple, quick and good between sets or after a desk session.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and reach both straight arms behind you.
Lift your arms slightly and open your chest without leaning back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1851.description: An incline press with a small leg drive that lets you move heavier loads and trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Set an incline bench and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Dip slightly through your legs to start momentum.
Drive the bar up while pressing with your arms.
Lock out above your chest, then lower under control.
Keep your core braced and your lower back from arching.

1915.description: A seated reach toward the toes that lengthens the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight out in front of you.
Reach toward your toes with a long back until you feel the back of the thigh stretch.
Keep your knee straight but not locked, and avoid rounding your back too much.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

1979.description: A cross body stretch that loosens the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and bring one arm across your chest.
Use the opposite hand to press the arm toward you until the shoulder and upper back stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.

2107.description: Lets the belly sink and the chest lift from all fours to stretch the front of the trunk and mobilise the spine.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while looking slightly forward.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for a couple of seconds, then return to neutral.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

2363.description: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体悬浮在空中。
稍微向前倾，弯曲肘部降低身体，直到胸部位于杠铃上方。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2555.description: A glute bridge with a band around the thighs that adds hip activation.
instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band around your thighs.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

2683.description: A wrist curl with an overhand grip that builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists drop so the bar hangs down.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your forearms still.

2747.description: A machine hip thrust that squeezes the legs inward, training the inner thighs and glutes.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads between or around your legs as set.
Brace your core.
Thrust your hips up while squeezing your legs inward.
Hold the squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

2811.description: A combined move where a leg rotation pairs with an overhead press with a barbell. Trains legs, trunk and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
Alternate sides on each rep.

2875.description: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

2939.description: Circling a kettlebell around your head, also called a halo. It loosens the shoulders and warms up the upper back.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height.
Stand tall with your abs braced.
Circle the bell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your hips and ribs still.
Finish the reps, then reverse direction.

3195.description: A lying machine leg curl that starts with both legs and finishes with one. It targets the hamstrings with a controlled, heavier lowering phase.
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your legs on the lever pad, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body still, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整机器以适合您的身体，然后坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上。
将双腿放在脚踝上方的杠杆垫上。
抓住机器两侧的手柄以提供支撑。
保持上半身不动，呼气并将双腿向上弯曲至臀部。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢降低双腿回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3259.description: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

3323.description: The first half of a turkish get up, moving from lying to a seated position with the kettlebell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and core strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

3387.description: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.
instructions: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

3515.description: A side-lying V-up that targets the obliques.
instructions: Lie on one side with legs together and an arm extended overhead.
Lift your legs and upper body at the same time.
Reach your top hand toward your feet.
Lower with control, not resting.
Keep your movement smooth.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

3579.description: Roll back onto the floor holding a kettlebell from a squat, then roll up into a squat again.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and squat down.
Sit back and roll onto your back, keeping the bell close.
Use momentum to roll forward onto your feet.
Stand up out of the squat.
Keep a tight grip and repeat smoothly.

3643.description: A weighted side-to-side squat, shifting weight deeply over one leg with the other straight. It trains the glutes, quads and adductors.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and keeping your chest up.
Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating between legs.
instructionsZh: 站立时双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
用双手将重物放在胸前。
将您的体重转移到一侧，并通过弯曲您转移一侧的膝盖来降低身体，同时保持另一条腿伸直。
尽可能降低身体高度，同时保持平衡并挺胸。
推动弯曲腿的脚跟以返回到起始位置。
在另一侧重复，双腿之间交替。

3707.description: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.

3771.description: A hip hinge paired with a one-arm band row. It works your posterior chain and your upper back.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3835.description: A hangboard hold with your elbows bent to 90 degrees. It builds pulling strength and grip.
instructions: Grip the hold and pull yourself up until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulders back and your core tight.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down under control.
Rest before the next hold.

3899.description: A bent-over row with a band that strengthens the mid back and lats.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

3963.description: A one-arm curl done lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swinging.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging, dumbbell in hand.
Keep your upper arm vertical.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower fully.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

4027.description: A band warm-up that pulls the arms behind the body to activate the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall holding the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the band apart and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly then return slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without arching your lower back.

4091.description: A floor exercise where you lift your limbs off the ground and add a rotation, training the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Rotate your torso slightly to one side while holding the lift.
Return to the center, then rotate to the other side.
Lower down with control and keep your neck neutral.

4155.description: A seated calf raise with weight resting on your thighs. The bent knee focuses the work on the soleus beneath the calf.
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and the weight resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised edge if possible.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly below the edge for a stretch.
Hold the weight steady throughout.

4219.description: A safety bar squat with your heels raised on a small platform. The elevation lets your knees travel forward to target the quads.
instructions: Place plates or a wedge under your heels in front of the rack.
Unrack the safety bar and step onto the platform.
Keep your chest upright and brace your core.
Squat down with your knees tracking over your toes.
Pause briefly at the bottom.
Press up and rack the bar when done.

4283.description: Rotating the foot in slow circles to mobilise the ankle. It warms up the joint and relieves stiffness.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended or crossed over your knee.
Hold your lower leg steady.
Draw slow circles with your foot.
Do 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Repeat on the other foot.

4347.description: A standing single-leg curl on a lever machine. It targets the hamstrings one side at a time.
instructions: Stand facing the machine and set the pad behind your working ankle.
Hold the supports for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

4411.description: A seated barbell raise that lifts the bar high in front of you, working the front delts.
instructions: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, in front of your thighs.
Keep your back straight and your core braced.
Lift the bar forward and up to eye level or higher.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly under control.

4475.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the deep hip flexor (iliopsoas). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your deep hip flexor (iliopsoas) while lying face down.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Use gentle pressure and breathe slowly so your stomach stays relaxed.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4539.description: A narrow push-up variation with the hands close together, putting extra load on the triceps and inner chest.
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands under your chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows tracking back close to your ribs.
Pause briefly just above your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight so your hips do not sag.

4603.description: A pipe-assisted stretch for the lats, shoulders and wrists that helps you get into a comfortable front rack position.
instructions: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Lower the elbows and repeat.

4667.description: A triceps extension using your own bodyweight against a stable surface. It targets the back of the arms.
instructions: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.

4731.description: A dumbbell bench press performed with your hips lifted in a glute bridge. It trains the chest while your glutes and core hold you stable.
instructions: Lie on the floor or a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Plant your feet and drive your hips up into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower them to chest level under control.
Keep your hips high for the whole set.

4795.description: A step-up onto a bench using one leg at a time. It builds strength in the thighs and glutes and helps balance.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4859.description: A push-up that finishes by rotating into a side plank. It trains the chest and trunk.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.

4923.description: A reverse fly using rings while leaning back. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the rings with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your elbows only slightly bent.

4987.description: Lying on your back, you trace a figure eight in the air with your legs. It keeps the lower abs and hip flexors under tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Trace a figure eight in the air with your feet, slowly and in control.
Keep your legs close together.
Change direction halfway through the set.

5051.description: Hips lifted into a bridge, you twist from side to side. It trains the trunk rotators and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat and arms out wide.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Rotate your knees and hips to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Stay controlled and keep your shoulders on the floor.

5179.description: A standing cable row with a close grip. It trains your lats and mid back while challenging posture.
instructions: Attach a close grip handle to a cable at chest height and step back.
Stand with a slight knee bend and a braced core.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

5243.description: Lying on a bench with a low cable, extending the arms. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a low pulley behind your head.
Hold the bar or rope with your arms up over your face.
Keep your upper arms still.
Bend your elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back up.

5307.description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It trains hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar in front of you with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar while your free leg reaches back.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5371.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the neck. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under the base of your skull.
Place the roller under the neck and let your body weight settle onto it.
Gently turn your head slowly from side to side.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5819.description: Raise light dumbbells with thumbs pointing down, as if emptying a can. It targets the front and side shoulder.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing down.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to shoulder height.
Hold briefly without shrugging.
Lower slowly with control.

5883.description: A three-part arm combo: curl, press overhead, then lower behind the head for a triceps extension. It works the whole arm in one set.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.

6011.description: A side step paired with a rowing motion that works the rear shoulders and upper back while elevating your pulse.
instructions: Stand in a slight squat with your arms out in front.
Step to the side.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return your arms forward as you step back.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

6075.description: Alternating front raises with a bottle in each hand. It works the front delts.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand.
Raise one arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly as you raise the other.
Keep your torso still.
Breathe steadily.

6139.description: A deep squat paired with a trunk rotation. It opens the hips and upper back and improves rotation.
instructions: Lower into a deep squat with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the floor or inside your knee.
Rotate your chest and reach the other arm up toward the ceiling.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Return to the center and switch sides.
Keep your heels on the floor.

6267.description: A standing rotation of the forearms holding dumbbells. It builds forearm strength.
instructions: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees.
Rotate your palms up.
Rotate your palms down.
Repeat smoothly.
Keep your elbows pinned.

6523.description: A hack squat on a linear lever machine that loads your thighs and glutes along a fixed path.
instructions: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your feet to stand.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.

7419.description: A bridge with straight legs that shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

7547.description: Wide-stance goblet squat that targets the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.

7995.description: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out and up into a Y shape. It trains the shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.

8891.description: Hinging forward with a weighted bag on your back trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. It teaches a strong hip hinge.
instructions: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.

10043.description: A seated overhead press on the floor with legs straight, using one arm. It removes leg drive and challenges your trunk.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

10107.description: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.
instructions: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.

10427.description: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.
instructions: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.

10555.description: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

10747.description: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

10875.description: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.
instructions: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.

11259.description: A standing cable kickback that targets the glutes. It teaches you to extend the hip without arching your back.
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

11451.description: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

0059.description: A preacher curl performed while lying on the bench, isolating the biceps with no body swing.
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your arms extended over the edge, holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the bar until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在牧师长凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，手臂伸出边缘，反手握住杠铃。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续抬高杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0123.description: A wide-grip upright row, favouring the side delts and traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang in front of your thighs, arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and lift the barbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，双臂完全伸展。
保持背部挺直，呼气，将杠铃向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0187.description: A lying triceps extension using a cable, which keeps constant tension on the back of the arms. Good for building triceps size and strength.
instructions: Set a low pulley with a bar or rope and lie on a bench with your head near the stack.
Hold the handle with arms extended above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and bend only at the elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Pause when your forearms pass parallel to the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling and don't flare them.

0251.description: A bodyweight dip with a forward lean on parallel bars. It targets the lower chest, triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部，降低身体，直到肩膀低于肘部。
伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0315.description: A biceps curl performed on an incline bench. The stretched start position gives a good challenge to the biceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0379.description: A rear lateral raise with your forehead supported on a bench or pad. The support protects your lower back and keeps the focus on the rear delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将手臂向两侧举起，肘部保持轻微弯曲，直到与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0443.description: A standing or floor crunch where you bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, bring your left knee towards your right elbow, creating a twisting motion.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and your right knee towards your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，将上半身抬离地面，将右肘靠近左膝盖。
同时，将左膝移向右肘，形成扭转动作。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低上半身并将双腿伸展回到起始位置。
重复该动作，这次将左肘移向右膝，将右膝移向左肘。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0507.description: You lie flat and fold your body, bringing hands and feet together. It strongly trains the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms overhead.
Engage your core and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂举过头顶。
启动你的核心，同时抬起双腿和上半身，将双手伸向脚趾。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢放下双腿和上半身回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0571.description: Seated on a machine, you pull the handles one arm at a time toward your torso with a narrow grip. Targets the lats and mid back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your back straight and feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Pull one handle towards your torso while keeping the other handle stationary.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position and repeat with the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度和踏板位置以确保正确对齐。
坐在机器上，背部挺直，双脚平放在踏板上。
紧紧握住手柄，手掌相对。
在整个练习过程中保持挺胸、肩膀向后。
将一个手柄拉向您的躯干，同时保持另一个手柄静止。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将手柄返回到起始位置，并在另一侧重复此操作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0635.description: Lying on your back, you crunch up and rotate toward one knee, then the other. Targets the obliques and abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, rotating your torso to one side.
Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the floor.
Repeat on the other side, alternating sides with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地板上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面，将躯干旋转到一侧。
暂停片刻，然后将肩胛骨放回到地板上。
在另一侧重复，每次重复时交替进行。

0699.description: From a high plank, you tap one shoulder with the opposite hand. Works the shoulders and core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you push back up, lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder.
Return your right hand to the ground and repeat the push-up, this time lifting your left hand and tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps with each push-up repetition.
Maintain a stable core and avoid excessive hip rotation throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
当你向后推时，将右手抬离地面并轻拍左肩。
将右手放回地面并重复俯卧撑，这次抬起左手并拍打右肩。
每次重复俯卧撑时，继续交替拍肩。
在整个练习过程中保持核心稳定并避免臀部过度旋转。
重复所需的重复次数。

0763.description: A calf raise done with the smith bar for support and the toes on a raised edge. It trains the calves through a full range of motion.
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆调整到略低于肩膀的高度。
面向杠铃站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽，脚趾向前。
将脚掌放在台阶或平台的边缘，脚后跟悬空。
握住杠铃以提供支撑，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
尽可能高地抬高脚后跟，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0827.description: A standing take on the mountain climber with fast knee drives. It lifts your heart rate and works the core.
instructions: Stand tall with hands raised in front of you at chest height.
Drive one knee up toward your hands.
Switch legs quickly, running in place.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady, brisk pace.

0891.description: A back extension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Anchor the band and secure it across your upper back.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your torso up until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

0955.description: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.
